content.comment_body: Hi, can only panels programmed with [product_name] [version_no] be connected to [product_name]? Or can [product_name] also be used? Is it possible to connect any panel with an Ethernet interface to [product_name]? Thanks.

Hello [user_name], I assume you have already seen this FAQ: how can you set up a connection between a [product_name] [article_no] and an HMI panel? You will need to select the "S7-200" driver, which means you can also use [product_name] to program the panel. Any panel with Ethernet and the appropriate "S7-200" driver will work. Best regards,
